name: proofmerge
description: Make your coding agent verify its own change before it calls the work done: ProofMerge writes probes aimed at what the change could break, runs them on base and head in Docker, and returns PASS, REVIEW or BLOCK with replayable evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Verify your own change with evidence before you call it done
interface.longDescription: Make your coding agent verify its own change before it calls the work done: ProofMerge writes probes aimed at what the change could break, runs them on base and head in Docker, and returns PASS, REVIEW or BLOCK with replayable evidence.
defaultPrompt: Verify my branch with ProofMerge before we open the pull request.
